## IMPULSE 0.3.0

This release adds the cinematic launch sequence for the current IMPULSE prototype.

### Highlights

- The app now starts from a completely black screen and fades the IMPULSE chain-reaction artwork to full visibility over three seconds.
- Android 12+ native splash styling is black with no launcher-icon flash before the cinematic splash.
- The exact existing IMPULSE artwork is reused as the app splash asset without redrawing it.
- Launch instrumentation tests now advance through the splash before validating gameplay flows.
- Release preparation now creates a missing semver tag and dispatches the protected release workflow only after successful main-branch Android CI, security, and CodeQL checks.

The game remains offline-first, with no account, analytics, ads, backend, or Android `INTERNET` permission.

Release artifacts are signed with the project release certificate and published with SHA-256 checksums and GitHub artifact attestations.
